_meta.description: Role definitions and permission matrix for Yene Verify. Source of truth for both backend guards and mobile UI permission checks. Mirror of MASTER_CONTEXT.md §4.

ADMIN.description: Platform owner (Fuad). Web dashboard only — NOT in the mobile app.

MERCHANT.description: Business owner. Full control of own data and sub-merchants.

SUB_MERCHANT.description: Employee/cashier. Verifies on behalf of merchant. Limited view.

VERIFY_PAYMENT.description: Submit a receipt image for verification

VIEW_OWN_VERIFICATIONS.description: View verifications initiated by the current user

VIEW_ALL_BRANCH_DATA.description: View all verifications across all branches/sub-merchants

EXPORT_REPORTS.description: Export transaction reports as PDF or CSV

MANAGE_SUBSCRIPTION.description: Select packages and upload payment proof

VIEW_ALL_MERCHANTS.description: See all merchants on the platform (admin only)

MANAGE_BANKS_AND_APIS.description: Configure bank adapters and API settings (admin only)

BAN_USERS_HANDLE_FRAUD.description: Suspend accounts and handle fraud cases (admin only)

VIEW_OWN_AUDIT_LOG.description: View the audit log for own account

tenancy.rule: A user belongs to exactly ONE merchant OR is the merchant. Never multiple.
tenancy.adminBypass: Admin bypasses RLS via superuser context (web dashboard only)
